original_test_intent: Prove every mapped InfiniBand port transitions to LinkUp and Disabled as commanded and recovers normally through five flap cycles, with matching physical indication.
original_method: Map IB device/port/BDF/connector/peer; isolate traffic and retain alternate access; preserve baseline; operator controls approved down/up transitions; capture full ibstat/sysfs state and logs for each of five cycles; record LED observations; restore and verify final health.
manual_activity: Operator controls five IB flaps per mapped port and observes physical LEDs; IB owner isolates traffic, restores links and owns verdict.
required_inputs: Approved OS or fixture flap mechanism
Alternate access, isolation and recovery plan
safety_requirements: Do not flap production or ambiguous ports
Stop on unexpected state, traffic impact or failed recovery; no auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Capture synchronized read-only per-cycle IB state/logs
Correlate operator LED evidence and verify restoration
Do not perform unapproved flaps or verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Full ibstat is useful corroboration, but a static snapshot and ambiguous sysfs loop do not satisfy five flaps or physical LED observation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use exact-device/port full ibstat and `/sys/class/infiniband/<device>/ports/<port>/state` around each operator-controlled transition.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Five cycles per port, LinkUp/Disabled states, final normal condition and 10-minute allocations are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a cycle-indexed port-state table with operator action/LED and synchronized ibstat/sysfs/log evidence plus restoration checks.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable mapping, timing, isolation, abort/recovery and complete evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One read-only Active snapshot cannot demonstrate Disabled transition or recovery durability.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Flaps interrupt IB traffic and an incorrect port can affect unrelated fabric paths.

project_override_considerations: Owner must define down/up mechanism, per-state dwell, acceptable transition latency, required physical LED observation and ports in scope.
expected_evidence: Five indexed LinkUp/Disabled state pairs per port
Final restored traffic/management and normal port state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master requires five active link-flap cycles; DeepSeek only captures a static read-only IB state and cannot prove transitions or recovery.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution blocks without exact port/peer mapping, safe flap fixture, alternate access, operator/LED evidence or recovery oracle.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row395 Wistron-Networking-00384-V003: approve exact IB device/port/BDF/connector/peer mapping, OS versus fixture flap method, LinkUp/Disabled string and dwell/latency oracle, five-cycle scope, LED/operator evidence, isolation, alternate access and abort/restoration rules.

review_improvement: Turns a static IB snapshot into an attributable five-cycle state-transition and recovery audit for every approved port.
independent_technical_reasoning: An IB port shown Active once may still fail to disable, retrain or recover. Each cycle must bind the operator action to the same mapped device/port and preserve both logical state and physical indication; otherwise the intended durability coverage is lost.
